pages.text: Prepare and eat one specialty: Deep Sea Sushi, Vesper Stew or Mosquito Repellent Stew.

pages.title: An Unexpected Meal
pages.text: Special meals provide useful preparation for dangerous outings.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Combine deep fish into sushi, cook Vesper Wings into stew or use Triops eggs for mosquito-repellent stew. Toss carrots to both Triops parents; eggs can also hatch. One chosen dish is enough.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Lanternfish shoals rise nearer the surface at night and can reveal a chasm. Tripodfish live near the floor; native buckets preserve them and cooking/sushi uses their catch.
